verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents triggering tasks programmatically from your own backend code via the SDK (`trigger()`, `triggerAndWait()`). It never shows Trigger.dev exposing a custom inbound webhook URL that external services can call to start a run. Outbound failure-alert webhooks are a different capability, and a user reports having to build their own proxy to trigger tasks from outside the backend, so SDK triggering is a developer building block rather than this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload
